poc_scope: Environment: Dedicated reserved GPU pool (small) in NA with optional EU replica for failover tests
Canary plan: route 5% of production traffic (simulated) to Dedicated pool + monitor latency, errors, and quality
Model variants: primary = high-accuracy open model (fp16/8-bit), fallback = quantized lower-cost variant; test automatic fallback based on error/latency thresholds
Routing rules: policy-based routing by latency tier and cost; region failover configured (EU->NA) for simulated region outage
Rollback triggers: sustained p95 latency > 250ms for 3 minutes, error rate >2%, quality drop >5% on eval prompts
Metrics to monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost per token, error rate, eval-set accuracy/ROUGE/F1 for key prompts
Success criteria: p95 < 180ms for chat happy path, fallback behavior exercises successfully, no critical security gaps, pricing within $25k-$50k ARR band
requirements_summary: Workloads: chat-driven product support flows + doc search + personalization/reranking. Throughput target: 100 QPS peak (batched), typical 10-20 QPS. Latency SLO: p95 < 180ms. Need VPC + KMS + audit logs + potential EU residency for subset of data.
